title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Loyalty Upgrade Discount on Plus Monthly
content:
# Loyalty upgrade discount on a move to Plus Monthly (Wayfare Pass)

**Clause.** On a move up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, the loyalty upgrade discount is 10 percent for a member who has held the Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership for at least 24 whole months and has at least 20 trips charged a fare in the last three months; it is 5 percent for a member who does not meet that tier but has held the membership for at least 12 whole months and has at least 6 such trips; it is nothing for anyone else.

**Effect.** The discount is taken off the Plus Monthly upgrade charge as that percentage of the Plus Monthly membership fee of 19.99. The percentage is always of the 19.99 fee itself; the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Records read

- **Whole months held**: whole calendar months from the membership's enrollment date to the change date.
- **Trips charged a fare**: fare charges on the member's trips in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) dated in the last three months, one per trip.

## Tier table

| Whole months held | Trips charged a fare, last three months | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | 20 or more | 10 percent |
| 24 or more | 6 to 19 | 5 percent |
| 12 to 23 | 6 or more | 5 percent |
| 12 or more | under 6 | nothing |
| under 12 | any | nothing |

## Edges (hypothetical members)

- 24 months and 20 trips: 10 percent; 24 months and 19 trips: 5 percent; 23 months and 20 trips: 5 percent.
- 12 months and 6 trips: 5 percent; 11 months and 30 trips: nothing; 12 months and 5 trips: nothing.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

At 10 percent the amount taken off is 1.999 (10 percent of 19.99); at 5 percent it is 0.9995. Neither is rounded before the charge's final rounding.
